question: 20261030-1250-research-data-apis-35cd-u04-q02: with a free OpenWeather key, does the 61st call in a minute answer HTTP 429, how long does the block last in practice, and does the key reach any bulk.openweathermap.org snapshot or archive file?
why: unverified: behind a sign-up (an email sign-up behind a reCAPTCHA; no account was created). Documented: the FAQ says more than 60 calls a minute answers 429 and the blocking system suspends an account for a couple of hours to several days at random; the key guide asks for a repeat after 10 minutes and says an email warning comes before a suspension; the FAQ says a Free subscription that asks for another plan's data answers 401; the pricing page locks Bulk Download (standard presets) for Free. Measured with no key: bulk.openweathermap.org/snapshot answers 401, and bulk.openweathermap.org/sample/ serves a directory and a 4002796-byte city list with HTTP 200. A one-key test settles it: 61 calls inside one minute, then one call every 10 minutes until a call answers 200 again, then one request to bulk.openweathermap.org/snapshot/weather_14.json.gz with the key.
